title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN - Oct 11, Shina Ansari, Vice President and Head of Iran’s Department of Environment made remarks in an interview.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN - Oct 11, Shina Ansari, Vice President and Head of Iran’s Department of Environment made remarks in an interview."

""
"=============="

"SOT1, Shina Ansari, Vice President and Head of Iran’s Department of Environment (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:41): "The environmental damage they cause is not limited by political borders. In practice, the efforts the world is making in the field of climate change, such as reducing greenhouse gas emissions and lowering carbon footprints, are effectively neutralized and rendered ineffective by these transgressions that fall outside international rules. Further discussions on these issues, including environmental pollutants and the damage and destruction caused to biodiversity and natural habitats, have fortunately been documented. We will certainly demand action on these matters at the climate change summit and follow up on them.""

"SOT2, Shina Ansari, Vice President and Head of Iran’s Department of Environment (Farsi)-(00:42 - 01:14): "Under international protocols, we must accept environmental destruction as an independent crime. This is a very important point. In any case, the significant point is that, firstly, unfortunately, the United States has currently withdrawn from many of these environmental agreements, including those related to climate change, and no expectations are held, but we must make our efforts anyway and make our demands at the global level.
